test_suite: AgroVision AI 2.0 - Phase 5 Automated Diagnosis Engine Test Suite

test_results.message: Model output indices 26, 27 correctly resolved to canonical disease IDs dis_tomato_early_blight and dis_tomato_late_blight.
Correctly detected duplicate index 0 and out-of-bounds index 999, halting with status invalid_input.
TensorFlow runtime DLL block reported honestly as model_unavailable without fabricating predictions.
Correctly caught empty required fields and rejected with validation error.
Selected unsupported crop returned explicit status unsupported_crop with referral to extension clinic.
Disagreement between farmer Chilli and visual model Tomato preserved as crop_mismatch without silent overwrite.
Apple + ears_cobs flagged as incompatible organ and triggered organ_mismatch abstention.
Contradiction between healthy model prediction and severe rot/wilting triggered expert_review_recommended.
Handled sparse/unsure answers gracefully without failing pipeline execution.
Detected close candidate margin (0.04 < 0.15) and correctly reported multiple_candidates differential diagnosis.
Low scores (<0.35) and unsure symptoms correctly triggered abstention status insufficient_evidence.
Verified provisional decision thresholds are explicitly configured and documented as uncalibrated heuristics.
Response metadata accurately labels scores as uncalibrated_softmax without pretending statistical calibration.
Verified diagnostic report includes 3 authoritative agricultural knowledge-base references.
Successfully generated 2 targeted follow-up questions from Phase 4 config to resolve ambiguity.
Full diagnosis response payload strictly conforms to JSON Schema draft-07 specification.
Verified 100% regression protection: /predict/predict-yield executed with success=True and valid yield output.
